verses.en: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.
verses.sm: Isaraelu i Mesepa, o loo faapea, E leai so tatou e avatu lona afafine e fai ma aya i so sa Peniamina.

verses.en: And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;
verses.sm: Ona oo atu lea o le nuu i Peteli, ua latou nonofo ai i luma o le Atua, ua oo i le afiafi. Ona leo tetele ai lea i latou ma fetagisi i le tagi tele.

verses.en: And said, O LORD God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?
verses.sm: Ua latou fai atu, le ALII e, le Atua o Isaraelu, pe se a le mea ua 00 mai ai lenei mea ia Isaraelu, ina ua mavae atu le tasi itu aiga o Isaraelu i lenei aso?

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
verses.sm: Ona oo lea i le taeao ua ala usu le nuu, ua latou faia i lea mea le fata faitaulaga, ma avatu ai taulaga mu ma taulaga faafetai.

verses.en: And the children of Israel said, Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the LORD? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the LORD to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.
verses.sm: Ua fai ane le fanauga a Isaraelu, O ai ea so le au itu aiga uma o Isaraelu na le o ae i le ALII i le faapotopotoga? aua sa latou faia le tautoga mamafa i se na te le alu ae i le ALII i Mesepa, sa faapea, E matuā fasiotia lava o ia.

verses.en: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.
verses.sm: Ua salamo foi le fanauga a Isaraelu ona o Peniamina lo latou uso, ua latou faapea ane, Ua vavaeeseina i lenei aso le tasi itu aiga nai ia Isaraelu;

verses.en: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?
verses.sm: se a se mea tatou te faia ia maua avā ma e ua totoe? aua ua tauto i tatou i le ALII, e le avatu lava o tatou afafine e fai ma latou ava.

verses.en: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the LORD? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.
verses.sm: Ona fai ane ai lea o i latou, O ai so le au itu aiga o Isaraelu na le alu ae i le ALI i Mesepa? Faauta foi, e lei sau se tasi i le toagalauapi i le faapotopotoga mai lapese-Kiliata.

verses.en: For the people were numbered, and, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.
verses.sm: Ona latou faitaulia lea o le nuu; faauta, ua le i ai se tagata o e nonofo i lapese-Kiliata.

verses.en: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.
verses.sm: to Ona aauina ai lea e le faapotopotoga o tagata e sefulu afe ma afe e lua o e totoa; ua fai atu ia te i latou, o loo faapea, O ia, ina outou fafasi i le pelu o e nonofo i lapese-Kiliata, o fafine atoa ma tama iti;

verses.en: And this is the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.
verses.sm: a o lenei le mea ton te faia, O tane uma, ma fafine uma ua tanea ia faaumatia i latou.

verses.en: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
verses.sm: Ua latou maua i e na nonofo i lapese-Kiliata o teine taupou e toafa selau, o e na le tanea; ua latou aumaia i latou i le toagalauapi i Sailo i le nuu o Kanana.

verses.en: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.
verses.sm: Ona aau atu lea nisi e le faapotopotoga uma, ua tautalatala ma le fanauga a Peniamina, sa i le papa o Rimoni; ua valaau ia i latou, ua ola le taua.

verses.en: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.
verses.sm: Ua toe foi Peniamina i ia ona aso, ona latou avatu lea o ava ia i latou e na faasaoina mai fafine o Iapese-Kiliata; a e lei tofu ai i latou.

verses.en: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua salamò le nuu ona o Peniamina; aua ua lepetia e le ALII itu aiga o Isaraelu, ua leai se tasi.

verses.en: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?
verses.sm: Ua fai ane toeaina o le faapotopotoga, Se a sa tatou mea e fai mo e totoe, ia maua avā, auā ua faaumatia fafine o Peniamina?

verses.en: And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua fai ane, la faia lava le tofi mo e ua sao O Peniamina, ina ia le tineia se itu aiga o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.
verses.sm: A o i tatou, tatou te le mafaia ona avatu ni o tatou afafine e fai mà latou aya, aua ua tauto le fanauga a Isaraelu, o loo faapea, Ia malaia se na te avatu se ava ia Peniamina.

verses.en: Then they said, Behold, there is a feast of the LORD in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Beth-el, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth-el to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.
verses.sm: Ona latou fai atu lea, Faauta, o le tausamiga i le ALII e faia i Sailo i lea tausaga ma lea tausaga, o loo i le itu i matu o Peteli, i gagac o le ala tele e alu ae nai Peteli i Sekema, ma le itu i toga o Lepona.

verses.en: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;
verses.sm: zo Ua latou fai atu i le fanauga a Peniamina, o loo faapea, O ia, ina lamalama i tovine,

verses.en: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
verses.sm: ZI ma outou vaavaai; faauta foi, afai e o atu teine o Sailo e fai le siva, ona outou o atu lea ai tovine, ma outou toso ma outou ia taitasi ma lana avà ai teine o Sailo; ona outou o lea i le nuu o Peniamina;

verses.en: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give unto them at this time, that ye should be guilty.
verses.sm: afai foi e o mai ia te i matou o latou tama, po o latou tuagane, e tagi mai ia te i matou, ona matou fai atu lea ia te i latou, Ia alofa ia i latou ona o i matou, aua na matou le faasao ni fafine i le taua, ia tofu le tagata ma lana ava; aua e le o outou na foai atu ai ia te i latou i nei ona po, ina neʻi nofo sala ai outou.

verses.en: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.
verses.sm: Ua faia faapea e le fanauga a Peniamina, ua latou fai ma latou aya e na sisiva, na latou toso e faatatau ma i latou; ona latou o lea, ma foi atu i o latou Sava nuu, ma latou faia o latou aai, ma latou nonofo ai.

verses.en: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.
verses.sm: Ona o ai lea i ia ona aso o le fanauga a Isaraelu ai lea mea, e taitasi i lona itu aiga ma lona aiga; ua latou o ese i lea mea e taitasi i lona tofi.

verses.en: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
verses.sm: O ia ona aso sa leai se tupu ia Isaraelu, ua taitasi ma fai le mea e tusa i lona lava manatu.
